svg.desc: SW FMEA failure chains, sheet 8 of 13 (SWF rev 1.5): failure modes SWF-046 to SWF-057 (5 failure modes, 11 causes), each drawn as structure element, function, failure mode with severity, guideword and end effect, and its causes with occurrence, detection, Action Priority and actions.
svg.text: Figure 3-6 · SW FMEA failure chains — sheet 8 of 13
SWF rev 1.5 · BL-006 · draft · SWF-046 … SWF-057 · 11 causes on this sheet
FAILURE CAUSE · O · D · AP · ACTIONS (STEPS 4–6)
with the request bit cleared when lateral
control is not active; send the ACC…
ACC acceleration command differs from controlsd's
request (higher, lower or faster changing) within the panda
The 4 m/s³ windup/winddown limit is applied before the pitch
compensation and the PID (carcontroller.py:197-238), so the sent
command has no rate limit; pitch comes from CC.orientationNED…
controlsd passes aTarget through unchanged up to the panda limits
Negative acceleration sent in ACC_CONTROL while
End effect: Braking while not engaged (HE-04.4)
The Toyota CarController takes pcm_accel_cmd from
the inactive value relies on LongControl returning 0 in its off state…
Deliver every 10 ms control step to the
vehicle, and stop sending item frames when
Control step late, repeated or missing, or item frames
End effect: Abrupt loss of steering assist in a curve; the
soft-disable alert comes at the same time, not before
controlsd raises on input it does not guard and exits; the 100 Hz
loop has no exception handling. The example of BL-004, int(NaN)
when lateralDelay is not finite (latcontrol_torque.py:100), is guarde…
Loop overrun or scheduling delay (Python, CTRL_HIGH on core 4,
controlsd.py:237); Ratekeeper only monitors (228-233) and the loop
is paced by selfdriveState; card actuates the latest carControl eac…
CarController torque limits equal the panda limits (values.py:20-21,
46-47 vs safety/modes/toyota.h:269-274), so any rounding or future
change of one side (SWF-ACT-003) makes the panda block frames.…
state, vEgo and EPS fault from current
vehicle CAN, and report invalid or missing…
Vehicle input lost, delayed or frozen while carState still
reports it as current and valid
End effect: Automated control not released on a driver brake or
cancel seen only by the host
Frozen frames are not detectable on the host: no Toyota RX
message carries a counter, and BRAKE_MODULE 0x226 and
WHEEL_SPEEDS 0xAA carry neither checksum nor counter…
Message timeouts are learned at run time. A message read by
carstate.py is registered on first access with an assumed 1 Hz, i.e.
a 10 s timeout, until more than 1 s of samples gives its rate…
A frame with a bad checksum is dropped without a timestamp
refresh, so the last good value stays in carState until the message
times out (10 learned periods) and canValid then needs 5…
Safety-relevant carState field decoded with the wrong
sign, scale or bit for the Corolla TSS2
End effect: Automated control not released on brake or cancel
Defect in the Toyota DBC or in carstate.py signal use
Short frames are not rejected: the parser skips only frames over 64
bytes and reads missing bytes as 0 (parser.py:219, dbc.py:66), so a
truncated BRAKE_MODULE reads BRAKE_PRESSED = 0 with no…

S = severity of the failure mode (max of its effects); O / D = occurrence / detection of the cause; “in <element>” = structure element where the cause lies; “→” = linked failure mode in another FMEA; hazard = HARA hazard of an end effect.
